description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score varies with the number of tokens for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information.” The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from 48 to 58 with tick labels at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. The MATTER (ours) series is drawn as a solid pink line with circular markers and a translucent pink band around it; it starts near 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, dips slightly around 0.6–0.7 (about 54.5 to 54.3), rises to about 57.0 at 0.8, remains around 56.3 at 0.9, peaks near 57.9 at 1.0, then declines through about 55.4 at 1.1 and about 53.0 at 1.2, stays near 52.6 at 1.3, increases to about 53.5 at 1.4, and ends near 50.9 at 1.5. The “w/o material information” series is a solid purple line with circular markers and a translucent purple band; it begins around 52.5 at 0.5, stays near 52.6 at 0.6, rises to about 54.1 at 0.7, drops to about 53.3 at 0.8 and remains near 53.3 at 0.9, decreases slightly to about 52.9 at 1.0 and about 52.8 at 1.1, continues down to about 52.4 at 1.2 and about 51.7 at 1.3, rises to about 53.3 at 1.4, and then drops to about 47.9 at 1.5.
